import { CsrfResponse, SessionResponse } from "../shared/schemas.ts";

export class Gate {
  active = 0; maxActive = 0;
  private queue: Array<() => void> = [];
  async run<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    if (this.active >= 20) await new Promise<void>(resolve => this.queue.push(resolve));
    else this.active++;
    this.maxActive = Math.max(this.maxActive, this.active);
    try { return await fn(); }
    finally { const next = this.queue.shift(); if (next) next(); else this.active--; }
  }
}
export const initialLoans = (index: number) => index < 20 ? Array.from({ length: 250 }, (_, n) => `seed-loan-${index + n * 20}`) : [];
export interface Client { cookie: string; csrf: string; loans: string[] }
export interface Reply { status: number; body: unknown; ms: number }
export function transport(base: string, gate: Gate, signal: AbortSignal) {
  return async (path: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Reply> => {
    const started = performance.now();
    const deadline = AbortSignal.any([signal, AbortSignal.timeout(5000)]);
    return gate.run(async () => {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(base + path, { ...init, signal: deadline });
        const body: unknown = response.status === 204 ? null : await response.json();
        return { status: response.status, body, ms: performance.now() - started };
      } catch { return { status: 0, body: null, ms: performance.now() - started }; }
    });
  };
}
export async function login(base: string, index: number, password: string, gate: Gate, signal: AbortSignal, onPost: () => void): Promise<Client> {
  return gate.run(async () => {
    const init = { signal: AbortSignal.any([signal, AbortSignal.timeout(5000)]) };
    const pre = await fetch(base + "/api/auth/csrf", init);
    if (pre.status !== 200) throw new Error(`csrf-status-${pre.status}`);
    const { csrfToken } = CsrfResponse.parse(await pre.json());
    const preCookie = pre.headers.getSetCookie().find(c => c.startsWith("pre_csrf="))?.split(";")[0];
    if (!preCookie) throw new Error("pre-cookie-missing");
    onPost();
    const response = await fetch(base + "/api/auth/sign-in", { ...init, method: "POST", headers: { cookie: preCookie, "content-type": "application/json", "x-csrf-token": csrfToken }, body: JSON.stringify({ email: `workload.${index}@example.test`, password }) });
    if (response.status !== 200) throw new Error(`signin-status-${response.status}`);
    const session = SessionResponse.parse(await response.json());
    const cookie = response.headers.getSetCookie().find(c => c.startsWith("sid="))?.split(";")[0];
    if (!cookie) throw new Error("session-cookie-missing");
    const confirmed = await fetch(base + "/api/auth/me", { ...init, headers: { cookie } });
    if (confirmed.status !== 200) throw new Error(`session-status-${confirmed.status}`);
    SessionResponse.parse(await confirmed.json());
    return { cookie, csrf: session.csrfToken, loans: initialLoans(index) };
  });
}
export const headers = (client: Client) => ({ cookie: client.cookie, "x-csrf-token": client.csrf });
